prompt:
A landscape 16:9 desktop website first viewport. This is a real website UI, not a photograph of an alarm clock. The entire page layout IS a seven-segment LED mask: every glyph, label, and number is built from the same eight-cell segment grammar. No card grid, no hero photograph, no rounded SaaS cards, no glassmorphism, no stock nightlife photos.

REGION 1 — SLIM TOP BAR (about 8% of viewport height, full width): Matte near-black #0A0B0C strip. Left: wordmark KONSTANZ spelled in small amber LED seven-segment cells, #F0A020, slightly dimmer than the main clock. Right: four unlabeled-looking nav cells in a row — Discover, Explore, Weekend, Saved — each word sitting inside a ghost-cell brown #3A2010 seven-segment block so they look like unlit clock cells that happen to hold nav. Discover cell is slightly more lit (selected). No hamburger, no search icon, no auth, no tickets, no Create.

REGION 2 — THE CLOCK FACE (dominates the viewport, about 55% height, centered, the largest thing on the page): A rigid mask of huge time cells showing 22:00. Four giant seven-segment digits 2 2 : 0 0 in bright amber LED #F0A020, glowing like a door-clock, segments thick and beveled like real LED bars on a matte black panel. Colon is two stacked amber cells. Unlit leftover segments of each digit remain visible as designed ghost cells in #3A2010 — absence drawn as deliberately as light. This is Student Night, the selected night. Directly under the huge 22:00, a smaller seven-segment cell row spells STUDENT NIGHT in amber. Below that, two even smaller cell rows: CLUB XYZ and door price as a gas-station totem of digits 5,00 with a euro mark, all in the reserved scoreboard green #6BFF4D — the one night you are going. Green is used ONLY here, nowhere else.

REGION 3 — GHOST NIGHT ROWS (about 22% height, stacked below the main clock, still the same rigid cell grid, not cards): Two unlit-segment rows, visibly ghosted in #3A2010 brown with only the faintest amber hint so they remain readable as times you are not going to. Top ghost row: 23:00 in medium seven-segment digits, then TECHNO FRIDAY and BLECHNEREI and 8,00 as dimmer cells. Bottom ghost row: 21:00, LIVE MUSIC, BAR CENTRAL, FREE — all ghost cells, designed unlit segments, same mask geometry as the hero time. House Saturday is not shown in this first viewport. No photos, no venue thumbnails.

REGION 4 — PRICE TOTEM (right side of the main clock, about 18% width, aligned to the 22:00 block): A vertical gas-station digit totem showing the selected door as stacked seven-segment figures: a small EUR cell, then a large 5, then ,00 — scoreboard green #6BFF4D only. Same eight-cell mask as every other glyph. Feels like a petrol-price sign transplanted onto a club door clock.

MATERIALS: Real LED segment bars, slightly rounded rectangular capsules, faint inner glow on lit amber, designed-dark unlit cells with visible segment troughs. Instant swaps implied by the shared mask. Matte near-black #0A0B0C chassis filling all gutters; cells scale as whole units on a rigid grid. No rounded rectangle cards, no drop shadows as product chrome, no photography.

TYPE: One eight-cell seven-segment mask makes every glyph on the page — wordmark, nav, times, venue names, prices. No Helvetica, no geometric sans UI font. Absence is drawn.

VISITOR JOB: instantly readable when (22:00) and which door (Club XYZ, €5, Student Night).

Camera: straight-on desktop browser viewport, full-bleed site, no device bezel, no browser chrome, no mockup frame. Photoreal UI screenshot quality of a designed website, 16:9 landscape.
